notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Initially, in this devlog, we wanted to talk about our plans for skills and perks, but there was one happy event so we decided to dedicate this issue to it.

On Thursday, the finalists of the UNREAL ENGINE DEV CONTEST 2020 were awarded. This is an annual competition of indie teams. The competition is being held for the second time. You can learn more about this competition [url=https://unrealcontest.disgustingmen.com/2020/competition/]here[/url].

This year, 290 (!) games participated, and only 30 made it to the final! The list of nominations is simply huge, the jury consists of the most famous and large companies. Honestly, we didn't think we could make it to the final. But it turned out that we not only reached, but also won in one of the nominations! 
We were noted by the GAIJIN ENTERTAINMENT company - a huge THANKS to them. It is very easy to get lost among so many really cool games, especially for such a small project like ours. The winner in this category will receive feedback on the game and the potential for collaboration.

All the winners can be viewed [url=https://unrealcontest.disgustingmen.com/2020/winners/]here[/url].

The first achievement earned!

And from the development news ːsteamhappyː - a new main menu scene.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We weren't in touch for a long time, but there were reasons for that. We thought about it and decided to change the style of the game. Why not? After all, this is what prototypes exist for - to collect feedback and draw conclusions. Let's talk about the reasons for this decision.

We talked with publishers and many advised them to think about porting to mobile platforms and consoles. Unfortunately, the technology we are using for character animation does not work on mobile devices. So we will need to switch to traditional skeletal. In general, our current pipeline is focused on the speed of development, and optimization is not in the first place in it and, as a result, a large number of unoptimized assets. And now there is a great opportunity to fix everything at once.

The style changes from voxel to low poly - it looks more familiar and greatly reduces the load on the device. In addition, the characters will become more expressive and detailed and they will have improved animations. To begin with, we redid almost all the characters in the game, at the same time hooked the heaviest assets of the environment, added an outline, cel-shading. It turned out like this.

Please tell us what you think!
